class.name: BloodPool
class.brief_description: A blood pool rendered as a projected decal or a plane.
class.description: Displays the pool on a surface, with a delayed fade-in and an optional fade-out.

members.member: Optional material for the pool plane. Assigning a material selects the plane even on renderers that support projected decals.
Local Euler rotation in radians, relative to the receiving surface. The pool also applies a small random rotation around the surface normal.
Pool half-width (X), projection depth (Y), and half-length (Z), in meters. The plane uses only X and Z.
Color and opacity texture for the built-in pool. Leave empty to use the generated splatter.
Legacy interpolation setting. Pool size is fixed, and the built-in fade-in takes 0.3 seconds.
Fade-out duration in seconds. Fade-out begins one fifth of this duration after the node enters the scene. Use [code]0[/code] to keep the pool until it is removed.
Time in seconds before the pool starts fading in.
World-space size in meters of one noise tile on the built-in pool plane. Applies when [member use_world_space_tiling] is enabled.
Samples the built-in pool plane's noise in world space. Turn off to sample using the plane's UVs.
